content: Imwen Doulik en Papilon
Nin tapio, tohn sampah koaros ahnekipene soangen mahsenteieu, pwe re kin doadoahngki soangen lepin mahsen kan me duwepenehte wasa koaros.
Ni ar mwekimwekidlahng palimese, re ahpw lel wasa patapat kis nan Papilonia, wasa re kousoanla ie.
Irail eri ndapene nanpwungarail, “Nna, kitail umwunda pwehl oh wiahkihda lepin takai.” Eri, re ahpw wiahda lepin takai pwehl, mehn kou ihmw, oh pil onopada tahr, mehn kapasapene takai ko.
Irail ahpw nda, “Eri, met kitail wiahda ehu kahnimw, oh ehu imwen doulik, me imwi pahn leldalahng pahnlahng, pwe kitail en ndandla oh dehr mwarahkpeseng wasa kan nin sampah.”
KAUN-O eri ketidi pwe en mahsanih kahnimwo oh imwen douliko me aramas ako kauwadahr.
E ahpw mahsanih, “Eri, aramas pwukat koaros wiahki ehu, oh re kin lokaiahki lokaiateieu; met iei tepin me re pahn wiewia kohwei. Mwurin met re pahn mwadangete kak wiahda soahng koaros me re anahne.
Eri, kitail kohdihwei oh kapingada ar lokaia, pwe re en dehr wehwehkipene ar lokaia kan.”
KAUN-O eri ketin kalipeihrpeseng ong wasa koaros nin sampah. Irail eri tokedihsang ar wiewia kahnimwo.
Kahnimwo adaneki Papilon,
pwehki iei wasao me KAUN-O ketin kapingada lokaiahn aramas koaros, oh sang wasao me e ketin kalipeihrpeseng ong wasa koaros nin sampah.
Kadaudok en Sehm kan
Iet kadaudok en Sehm kan. Sounpar riau mwurin nohlik lapalapo, ni Sehm eh sounpar 100, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Arpaksad.
Mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 500 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Arpaksad eh sounpar 35, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Sela;
mwuri, e momourki sounpar 403 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Sela eh sounpar 30, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Eper;
mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 403 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Eper eh sounpar 34, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Pelek;
mwuri, e ahpw momourki sounpar 430 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Pelek eh sounpar 30, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Reu;
mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 209 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Reu eh sounpar 32, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Seruk;
mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 207 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Seruk eh sounpar 30, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Nahor;
mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 200 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Ni Nahor eh sounpar 29, e nainekihda pwutak emen, ede Tera;
mwuri, e ahpw pil momourki sounpar 119 oh nainekihda pil seri kei.
Mwurin Tera eh sounpar 70, e nainekihda Eipram, Nahor, oh Aran.
Kadaudok en Tera
Iet kadaudok en Tera kan: Tera semen Eipram, Nahor oh Aran. Aran semen Lohd.
Eri, Aran mehla nan uhdakeo, Ur nan Papilonia, nindokon eh pahpao eh momourte.
Aran semen Iska oh pil serepein men, Milka, en Nahor eh pwoud; oh Eipram pwoudikihda Sarai.
Sohte nein Sarai seri, pwehki ih lih depwen men.

Tera eri kahrehda nah pwutak Eipram, oh Lohd nein Aran, rien Eipram ohl, oh Sarai, en Eipram eh pwoud; irail koaros ahpw mweselsang Ur, kahnimw en Papilonia, pwe re en kolahng Kenan. Irail ahpw lel kahnimw Aran, wasa re kousoanla ie.
Tera sipalla wasao ni eh sounpar 205.
